text: A small scientific experiment starts with a clear question. Researchers prepare a measurement plan, select appropriate instruments, record observations carefully, and repeat the procedure. They compare results with expectations, report uncertainty, and preserve enough notes for another learner to reproduce their conclusions.

Software engineering becomes more reliable when developers write readable tests before changing core behavior. A test describes the intended input, expected output, and potential failure modes. Reviewers compare observed results against the specification, document tradeoffs, and avoid deploying unverified code to production environments.
